frontmatter.summary: Most prototype testers who quit did so because notes did not open without a connection.

new_pages.body:
# Prototype offline dropout

## Finding

In the prototype round 11 of 24 testers stopped within a week; the most common reason was that notes did not open offline.

## Evidence

- Kickoff, 2026-01-15: tester feedback summarized by the PM.
- Related: [[example--acme-notes-offline-sync]]
